csv_project_name: A&E Services for Hurlburt Field 2027 Civil/Structural
csv_scope_of_work: The 1st Special Operations Contracting Squadron at Hurlburt Field, FL is seeking qualified civil/structural engineering firms to perform Title I and Title II design services on all disciplines to include architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical and environmental. The submitting firms need to include all architectural and engineering disciplines either in-house or by consultant(s).
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering

services: Title I and Title II A&E design services; architecture; civil engineering; structural engineering; mechanical engineering; electrical engineering; environmental engineering; geotechnical engineering; utility engineering.
relevance_explanation:

- Target market is general building, not a clearly identifiable bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.

- Presolicitation only; no concrete project parameters, spans, areas, or sustainability ambitions stated.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. The document is a general A&E services presolicitation without a defined project scope, building size, or construction package, so no realistic cost estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No design fee is stated in the notice. Because the procurement is for broad multi-discipline A&E services without a defined project volume or construction budget, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be made.
references_qualifications: Qualified civil/structural engineering firms must provide all architectural and engineering disciplines either in-house or through consultants.
